params.text: Last time... the friends left Tokyo, and met Tara Treetop in the Whispering Forest.
But in the night, a red chilli smoke drifted into their camp...
And when it cleared, Dony was gone.
High on Mirchi Hill, in the Spice Fort, Dony had a new job.

lines: Faster, little cook! My sneezing curry must be PERFECT!
Why do you need a curry that makes people sneeze?
So Tokyo sneezes its silly little head off! Ha-CHOO-ha!
And see my ladle? The Orange crystal sits in its cup.
And where are YOU going, little cook?
Back to the pot! Stir! Ha-CHOO!

params.text: Tara led them up Mirchi Hill, to the gate of the Spice Fort.

lines: Two Grey Goons at the gate. Big, slow, and very grumpy.
We can't fight our way in. We need a plan.
I have a plan! We say please!
Better: we bring them... a delivery.
Doopi and Mooka, you go in the front door.
Doomi, Becky and I sneak in behind you.
And nobody does anything alone. Promise?
Like a jelly in a hat.
Spice delivery! Extra hot chillies for Madam Mirchi!
Hmm. You look like the glowing boy.
No no! He's the glowing... delivery boy!
Wait. Delivery boys... got any snacks?

beats.say: Mmm! Sweet! Don't tell the boss.
La la la, a pinch of fire...

lines: Psst! Doomi went with Doopi to find Dony.
We look for a way to beat Madam Mirchi.
Not one jalebi in this whole kitchen!
Mirchi hates sweet things. Everybody knows that.
Then I keep MY jalebis safe. Right here.
Listen! She keeps the Orange crystal in her ladle!
And she can't stand sweet things. One jalebi and she screams!
I stirred that pot for TWO DAYS. My arms are noodles.
Then we wait for Mooka and Tara, and we do it together.
Wait? The ladle is RIGHT THERE. I'll be quick!
The glowing boy, in MY kitchen! How sweet. I can't STAND sweet!
Give back the Orange crystal and nobody sneezes!

beats.say: Two little sweets, down the hole!
Now where did the others go?

lines: Doopi and Doomi are down there!
Then we get them out. Together.
I should have waited. Like you said. I'm sorry.
It's okay. We're together. That's what matters.
A good plan needs patience. So we wait, and we think.
Waiting... is the hardest kung fu.

params.text: Then, with a deep rumble, the cellar walls began to slide... closer... and closer.
